description: This file contains functions to create and return various audio and text model benchmarks, including Wav2Letter, DeepSpeech, Transformer, and MultiheadAttention, with associated training procedures and weight extraction.

methods.name: get_wav2letter
methods.description: Creates a Wav2Letter model, initializes inputs and labels, and returns a loss function for training.

methods.name: get_deepspeech
methods.description: Creates a DeepSpeech model with audio configuration, initializes inputs and labels, and returns a loss function for training.

methods.name: get_transformer
methods.description: Creates a Transformer model, prepares input data, and returns a loss function for training.

methods.name: get_multiheadattn
methods.description: Creates a MultiheadAttention model, initializes attention parameters, and returns a loss function for training.
